quarterly_data.quarter: Toho Titanium semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025) consolidated results: net sales JPY 41,044 million (down 6.2% year on year), operating income JPY 1,324 million (down 49.5%), ordinary income JPY 1,181 million (down 30.7%), net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 699 million (down 38.2%). From this half the company changed its inventory valuation method (first-in first-out to moving average), and prior-period figures are compared after retroactive application. Management states imported raw material and electricity prices have peaked out but remain at a high level.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 41,044 million (-6.2%); operating income JPY 1,324 million (-49.5%); net income JPY 699 million (-38.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toho Titanium semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Chemicals segment (main product ultra-fine nickel powder, mainly used in multilayer ceramic capacitors, MLCC): management states the effect of economic stagnation in China on MLCCs has largely bottomed out; distribution inventory adjustment still lingers, but demand itself is recovering across fields (demand from communications, automotive and industrial equipment continued to recover), and H1 sales volume was above the prior-year period. Segment net sales JPY 7,946 million (up 28.8%), segment operating loss JPY 487 million (prior-year loss JPY 815 million). Revenue from electronic component materials JPY 7,812 million (prior-year half JPY 5,979 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Chemicals sales JPY 7,946 million (+28.8%); operating loss JPY 487 million (vs JPY 815 million loss); electronic component materials JPY 7,812 million (vs JPY 5,979 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toho Titanium semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Metal titanium segment H1 FY2026: net sales JPY 27,144 million (down 17.3%), operating income JPY 1,612 million (down 52.0%). Management states sales of export sponge titanium for aircraft fell because the supply-chain adjustment stemming from various troubles at Boeing lasted longer than initially expected (aircraft-engine MRO demand stayed firm); sales for general industrial uses fell on overproduction of sponge titanium by Chinese makers; high-purity titanium for semiconductors was firm and above the prior-year level; on earnings, the report cites currency movements and price adjustments linked to market conditions. Revenue by product: titanium sponge JPY 17,785 million (prior-year half JPY 21,160 million), titanium ingot JPY 7,386 million (JPY 9,233 million), high-purity titanium JPY 998 million (JPY 1,122 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Metal titanium sales JPY 27,144 million (-17.3%); operating income JPY 1,612 million (-52.0%); high-purity titanium JPY 998 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Toho Titanium semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Catalysts segment H1 FY2026: net sales JPY 5,953 million (up 24.8%), operating income JPY 1,370 million (up 38.8%). Management states sales rose on a recovering trend in overall catalyst market demand, although some customers' catalyst demand recovery is still delayed by higher exports from polypropylene overproduction in China, and production capacity remains in excess because of new polyolefin plants.
quarterly_data.figure: Catalysts sales JPY 5,953 million (+24.8%); operating income JPY 1,370 million (+38.8%)
